definition: Theaitre (stylized as THEaiTRE) is an interdisciplinary research project investigating to what extent artificial intelligence is able to generate theatre play scripts.
details: The first theatre play produced within the project, AI: When a Robot Writes a Play, premiered online on February 26, 2021.
story: Picture a novelist who has read so much that, given a first line, they cannot help but write the next one. It makes new things by recombining everything it has ever seen. The result feels creative because it is memory, reshuffled at speed. It is prediction pushed forward — each next word, or pixel, guessed from everything that came before it. And that is Theaitre — making something new out of everything it has ever seen.
